top_issues: Palette lists ten destinations but no search-as-you-type demo state, no recent/frequent section, no keyboard hints per row
Right-aligned hints ('send money', 'invoice, QR') are helpful but inconsistent: some describe, some list nouns
Modal height wastes the viewport; could show two columns with pinned actions
No 'Sovereignty/evidence' alias hits (e.g. typing 'proof' or 'dispute') demonstrated
fixes: Add recents row and per-row key hints (↵ to open)
Unify hint style: verb phrase for all rows
Add keyword aliases: dispute→Manage→Dispute, proof→Sovereignty, csv→Activity

overall.verdict: A genuinely distinctive wallet: the one-scale bars, green/violet trust semantics, Before/After account preview and Sovereignty screen are best-in-class for making credit risk visible. It is held back by residual protocol jargon (frames, lanes, entity ids, HTLC 'secret'), inconsistent amount display in lists, clipped Desk numerals, and missing flows (invoice creation, dispute progress, board editing) that several target users need end-to-end.
priority_fixes: De-jargon the surface: replace frames/lanes/entity-id/'secret releases both legs' with plain language plus glossary links; keep hashes behind 'advanced' everywhere (Pay, Receive, Ownership, Desk)
Fix numeric legibility: scale order-book depth bars to size, never clip Desk table numerals, show amounts on every activity row (filled/closed swaps), render 'You receive' at full strength

Close the loop on risk CTAs: 'Cover it' as a real button on Home/Account/Sovereignty, feed uncovered debt into NEEDS ATTENTION, and add a dispute-progress view with the 1 d countdown and evidence bundle
Complete the money-in path for novices: clear TESTNET badging on faucets, address-book naming for recipients, and one shared 'prepare incoming capacity' component instead of three divergent copies
Fill the empty screens: Ownership gets add-signer/threshold actions and shares state, Lending gets annualized rate + pool risk + utilization, Receive gets encoded-amount confirmation under the QR
